nonnegotiables: All required capstone evidence must be present.
The Year 2 cumulative final must meet or exceed 80%.
Missing required evidence cannot be averaged away.
Taste, sales, gallery acceptance, prestige, follower count and virality are excluded from mastery.

rubric.criteria: Shows visible growth from baseline through developed work and revision evidence.
Demonstrates intentional control of relevant materials, techniques, edges, value/color, structure and presentation.
Explains decisions using observable evidence, goals, comparisons and tradeoffs.
Documents specific problems, tests, revisions and resulting changes.
Curates a purposeful body of work with explicit selection logic rather than quantity alone.
Maintains usable business, inventory, documentation, client/opportunity or project records.
Presents work clearly with appropriate context, captions, statement and feedback questions.
Recognizes ownership, permissions, contracts, licensing, image-use and risk questions; seeks qualified review where appropriate.
Can evaluate fit, terms, costs, deadlines, rights, logistics and application requirements without pay-to-play assumptions.
Sets realistic studio, portfolio, business, audience and opportunity priorities for the year after completion.

defense_prompts: What changed most from your Year 1 baseline, and what direct evidence proves it?
Which three decisions best demonstrate independent judgment?
What tradeoff did you accept in the final body of work and why?
What limitation remains unresolved, and what is the next useful test?
How will you protect your rights, records and professional boundaries after the certificate?
What are the first three actions in your 12-month continuation plan?
